description: A lighting company makes two types of lamps: desk-lamps and night-lamps. There is an expected demand of at least DemandDeskLamps desk-lamps and DemandNightLamps night-lamps each day. However, due to the size of their factory, they can make at most MaxDeskLamps desk-lamps and MaxNightLamps night-lamps per day. To satisfy a contract, a minimum of MinTotalLamps lamps must be made each day. The profit per desk-lamp sold is ProfitDeskLamp and the profit per night-lamp sold is ProfitNightLamp. The objective is to determine the number of desk-lamps and night-lamps to maximize profit while meeting demand and contract requirements.

DemandDeskLamps.definition: Minimum expected demand for desk-lamps per day

DemandNightLamps.definition: Minimum expected demand for night-lamps per day

MaxDeskLamps.definition: Maximum production capacity for desk-lamps per day

MaxNightLamps.definition: Maximum production capacity for night-lamps per day

MinTotalLamps.definition: Minimum total lamps to produce per day to satisfy contract

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total profit from producing desk-lamps and night-lamps"

constraints.description: The number of desk-lamps produced per day must be between DemandDeskLamps and MaxDeskLamps
The number of night-lamps produced per day must be between DemandNightLamps and MaxNightLamps
The total number of lamps produced per day must be at least MinTotalLamps

DeskLamps.definition: Number of desk-lamps produced per day

NightLamps.definition: Number of night-lamps produced per day
